author: Ariadne I
title: Osc2-CTX-FLoad (k=256, p=48): Factorized Loadings + Oscillatory SSM + Curvature
abstract: Factorized loadings L=U@V^T with increased projection rank p=48 (vs 32) to test capacity vs. compute trade-off. Uses oscillatory 2nd-order SSM factors with input-adaptive temporal gating, global horizon gating, residual copy head, and MAE+curvature loss.
